items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And he was “Torennce [sic].” Torencce [sic], mainly because when he played he tore in some notes.

ctx.x: Is that what Clark Terry called you?
Yeah, Clark Terry, yeah. Buddy DeFrigili [sic]! And he was “Torennce [sic].” Torencce [sic], mainly because when he played he tore in some notes.
And you were the only white guy in the band, I know you certainly some…
